item.tib: tshe dbang gsang ba yang zhun gyi 'phrin las rin chen sgron ma'i chog khrigs
item.coloph: de ltar tshe dbang gsang ba'i sgrub gzhung 'di/ rig 'dzin chen po sprul sku rnam gsum gyis/ nges med sprang po bdag la snyan du brgyud/ bdag gis sbas dang gsang rgya thub par byas/ dad ldan grogs po'i rkyen gyis bskul ba'i ngor/ gnas la khyad 'phags g.yung drung 'bar ba'i zhol/ dkar chag yi ge ris su bkod pa 'di/ rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro rnams la bzod par gsol/ bka' skyongs srung ma rnams la bzod par gsol/ mkhyen rtse yab sras gsum gyi thugs rje(yis/)rjes 'jug nyes pa'i bdud las rab rgyal nas/ 'bras bu rig 'dzin gral du gnas par shog dge legs 'phel/ bdag mi shig rdo rje rtsal gyis gu ger rgyud/ 'di bris dge rtsa mkha' mnyam don du bsngo//
